_note: FICTIONAL demo transcript: app 'Railo', study RL1, participant P03 (Czech speaker). Invented for the README example; no real session behind it. text_cs = verbatim (spoken language), text_en = analyst's translation used with render_quotes.py --translation text_en.

rows.speaker: moderator
rows.text_cs: Přečtěte si prosím ty tři cestující. Kolik z každého je ve vás?
rows.text_en: Please read about the three travellers. How much of each one is in you?

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Nejvíc Klára. Do Brna jezdím dvakrát týdně a jízdenku kupuju večer předem.
rows.text_en: Mostly Klára. I go to Brno twice a week and buy the ticket the evening before.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Trochu Tomáš, když jedu na výlet. Petra vůbec — to si platím sama.
rows.text_en: A bit of Tomáš when I go on a trip. Not Petra at all — I pay for that myself.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Jízdenky na vlak za třicet sekund. Tomu uvěřím, až to uvidím.
rows.text_en: Train tickets in thirty seconds. I'll believe it when I see it.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Takže tady hledám spoj a koupím jízdenku, nebo se zeptám asistenta.
rows.text_en: So here I search for a train and buy a ticket, or I ask the assistant.

rows.speaker: moderator
rows.text_cs: Kupte si jízdenku z Prahy do Brna na zítřek kolem půl osmé, k oknu.
rows.text_en: Buy a ticket from Prague to Brno for tomorrow around half past seven, by the window.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Brno, hlavní nádraží… a hledat.
rows.text_en: Brno, main station… and search.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Kde se tady mění datum? Tohle je všechno dneska.
rows.text_en: Where do you change the date here? This is all today.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Možná dole… ne, pořád dneska.
rows.text_en: Maybe further down… no, still today.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Aha, ta malinká ikonka. Tu jsem vůbec neviděla.
rows.text_en: Oh, that tiny icon. I didn't see it at all.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Zítra je sedmého, ne? Jo.
rows.text_en: Tomorrow is the seventh, right? Yes.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Okno… to je ta modrá, nebo ta šedá?
rows.text_en: Window… is it the blue one or the grey one?

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Sedm třicet dva, dobře… ale je to na zítra? Tady není datum.
rows.text_en: Seven thirty-two, fine… but is it for tomorrow? There's no date here.

rows.speaker: moderator
rows.text_cs: Co bylo nejtěžší?
rows.text_en: What was the hardest part?

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: To datum. Čekala bych ho hned vedle ‚Kam‘, ne až ve výsledcích.
rows.text_en: The date. I'd expect it right next to 'To', not only in the results.

rows.speaker: moderator
rows.text_cs: Teď to samé přes asistenta. Platit už nemusíte, stačí rezervovat.
rows.text_en: Now the same thing through the assistant. No need to pay, just book.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: To bylo rychlé. A píše tam středa sedmého, to je dobře.
rows.text_en: That was quick. And it says Wednesday the seventh, that's good.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Vezmu ten přímý v sedm třicet dva.
rows.text_en: I'll take the direct one at seven thirty-two.

rows.speaker: moderator
rows.text_cs: Věřila byste tomu, co asistent navrhne?
rows.text_en: Would you trust what the assistant suggests?

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Napůl. Je to rychlé, ale datum bych si stejně zkontrolovala na jízdence.
rows.text_en: Half-way. It's fast, but I'd still check the date on the ticket.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Psaní mě zdržuje. Na mobilu bych to radši namluvila.
rows.text_en: Typing slows me down. On my phone I'd rather say it out loud.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Jednička… devět. Hned jsem věděla, o co jde.
rows.text_en: Number one… nine. I knew right away what it was about.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Dvojka, jiný den… to dám čtyři. Bez té ikonky bych tam pořád byla.
rows.text_en: Number two, another day… I'll give it a four. Without that icon I'd still be there.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Ceny a časy devět, to bylo jasné.
rows.text_en: Prices and times, nine — that was clear.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Asistent… šest, možná sedm.
rows.text_en: The assistant… six, maybe seven.

rows.speaker: participant
rows.text_cs: Rychlost osm. To pomalé jsem byla já, ne aplikace.
rows.text_en: Speed, eight. The slow one was me, not the app.
